common.tagline: Edit Word files precisely — every day

home.title: A daily Word editor for your work
home.subtitle: Upload a .docx, click to edit, save or export — preserving document formatting as closely as possible.
home.featureSecure: Private files protected by your account
home.visualCaption: Native DOCX in the browser — core formatting preserved

login.title: Sign in
login.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm, or disable confirmations in Supabase Auth settings.

documents.title: My documents
documents.emptyBody: Create a blank Word/PDF/Excel or upload a file to start editing.
documents.dropBody: Drop a .docx, .pdf, or .xlsx, or click to browse.
documents.savePathPlaceholder: e.g. Report.docx or choose a path
documents.savePathHint: Optional. Use Choose to pick a folder/file on your device (Chrome/Edge), or type a file name to download a local copy after create.
documents.localSaveHint: Document created in Qalib. Local save was skipped or cancelled.

editor.pdfHint: Preparing PDF… when ready, tap Save PDF.
editor.pdfShareHint: Tap to share → Save to Files (no new tab, no browser print).
editor.exportPdfPathPlaceholder: Choose a location or leave empty to download
editor.exportPdfPathHintDesktop: After the PDF is ready, tap Download PDF. On Chrome/Edge you can also Choose a folder — the file is written with content, never empty.
editor.exportPdfPathHintIos: After the PDF is ready, tap Download PDF or Save to Files. Printing is never used. The location is chosen at that tap, not before.
editor.exportPdfFallbackHint: Save to Files lets you pick the folder. Download PDF saves it straight to your device.
editor.exportPdfShareFailed: Sharing was blocked. Use Download PDF instead.
editor.exportPdfErrorBody: The PDF could not be built. Please try again.
editor.largeFile: Large file; the browser may slow down.
editor.pageDeleteWarning: This removes the current PDF page permanently after save. This cannot be undone easily.
editor.editSelectionHint: Click inside a paragraph first, then edit.
editor.editTableHint: Tap a cell to edit. Use Tab to move between cells.
editor.structureHint: Paragraphs, tables, and images in this document.
editor.addImageHint: Pick an image to insert at the cursor
editor.imageCopyUnsupported: Images can’t be copied here — use Add image to insert again

aiChat.title: AI assistant
aiChat.subtitle: Edit this document with Gemma (free)
aiChat.emptyHint: Ask anything: read the file, organize points, bold/underline, add or delete — the assistant reads the document itself.
aiChat.editsFailed: Could not apply the edit — try a clearer request
aiChat.doneWithEdits: Done. Applied {count} edit(s) to the document.
aiChat.emptyReply: The model returned no clear reply. Try again with a more specific ask.
aiChat.micListening: Listening… stop anytime, then edit before sending
aiChat.micUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser
aiChat.micRecordFallback: Tap to record, then stop to convert to text
aiChat.micPermissionDenied: Microphone permission denied — allow access in browser settings
aiChat.micEmptyRecording: No speech captured — hold a bit longer, then stop
aiChat.micSttUnavailable: Voice transcription is not configured on the server. Set OPENAI_API_KEY (or STT_*) and redeploy.
aiChat.attachmentTooLarge: Image is still too large after compression — try a smaller one
aiChat.attachmentUnsupported: Unsupported file type. Use PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, or HEIC
aiChat.attachmentConvertFailed: Could not process this image — try JPG or PNG
aiChat.attachmentLimit: You can attach up to 3 images per message
aiChat.errorVision: This model does not support image analysis. Set OPENROUTER_MODEL in .env.local to a vision model (e.g. google/gemini-2.5-flash) and restart the server.
aiChat.errorRateLimit: OpenRouter free-model daily limit reached. Add credits or set OPENROUTER_MODEL in .env.local to a paid model, then restart the server.
aiChat.errorAuth: Invalid OpenRouter API key. Check OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env.local
aiChat.errorUpstream: OpenRouter is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

pdfEditor.pageDeleteWarning: This removes the current PDF page permanently after save. This cannot be undone easily.
pdfEditor.hint: Click existing text to replace it, or use the toolbar to add text, images, and tables.
pdfEditor.editTextHint: Type the replacement text. The original will be covered when you save.
pdfEditor.editTextHintAdd: Type the text to place on the page. Nothing is added until you confirm.
pdfEditor.editTextUnreadable: This PDF does not expose selectable text reliably. Cover the old area and type the new text below.
pdfEditor.arabicExportFailed: Could not export Arabic text. Your edits are still on screen — try again or simplify the text.
pdfEditor.layersHint: Editable layers are saved with the document. Export/download flattens them into the PDF file.
pdfEditor.layersEmpty: No layers yet. Add text, shapes, or images — they stay editable after Save.
